title: 云依助手 0.13.13
releaseNotes: Fixed redundant whole-page MQTT scrolling at default and scaled desktop sizes, including large text. Left-side connection, subscription and publishing controls scroll independently while the right message panel stays within the client. Message history and long payloads retain internal scrolling; narrow stacked layouts retain natural page scrolling. Validated empty, advanced authentication, long error, populated and selected-detail states without changing broker behavior.
